nodes.description: Mapping from NFT id to poem string; written in constructor and read by getSeedPoemById.
Constructor that initializes the poem mapping from the _poems array via a loop.
External view function returning the poem associated with _id.
Constructor parameter: array of poems used to populate the poem mapping.
Loop counter local variable used in the constructor initialization loop.
Function parameter: NFT id used as key to read from the poem mapping.

edges.reason: _poems array elements are written into the poem state mapping during construction.
Loop counter i determines which poem mapping slot is written in the constructor.
_id is used as the key when reading poem[_id] in getSeedPoemById.
Constructor performs state writes to the poem mapping.
getSeedPoemById reads from the poem state mapping and returns the value.
